texts: Hesper pours the boiled sea-water into the harbor at the end of the day.
Boiled sea-water does not serve for a second distillation.
An apprentice scrubs each cauldron with sand.

fields.sentence: Hesper pours the boiled sea-water into the harbor at the end of the day.

q2_gaps: a descriptive temporal NP filling a Time value ('at the end of the day') — it is not a calendar-term granularity, not one of the listed speech-anchored deictic constants, and not one of the listed day-part symbols (morning / afternoon / evening / night, dawn / noon / dusk), so the Time slot has no licensed filler for it
review.notes: That slot is filled with a coined multiword constant end_of_day carrying no decomposition and matching no listed constant class. The rest is right: motion-result obliques (Theme plus Goal, with no LocatedIn asserted on the water), 'boiled' kept as a participial adjective on its own Member atom rather than fused or lemmatized to 'boil', sea_water given genus water with the noun modifier unexposed, and no status atom on the simple present.

fields.sentence: Boiled sea-water does not serve for a second distillation.
parse: (: boiled_sw_no_serve (Implication (And (Member $x sea_water) (Member $x boiled)) (And (Member (sk_serve $x) serve) (Experiencer (sk_serve $x) $x) (For (sk_serve $x) (sk_distillation $x)) (Member (sk_distillation $x) distillation) (Ordinal (sk_distillation $x) 2 distillation))) (STV 0.0 0.9))

review.notes: The negated generic over an adjectivally-restricted bare mass subject takes the strength-0 distributing rule with the participial modifier as a premise conjunct, the purpose-sense 'for' takes the preposition-named oblique rather than Beneficiary, and the indefinite 'a second distillation' is a dependent Skolem function kept inside the denied consequent. The Ordinal scale slot is filled with the entity's own class symbol 'distillation', which reads as the associated-event scale but is degenerate against the entity's own Member atom.

fields.sentence: An apprentice scrubs each cauldron with sand.

review.notes: Matches the exists-forall shared-constant pattern exactly — indefinite subject as a top-level witness constant, rule ranging over (Member $y cauldron) at 1.0/0.9, and exactly one QuantifierPhrase companion on the quantified range. Patient for scrub (treatment applied) and Instrument with bare-mass 'sand' as a constant are both per doctrine.
